_doc: Combat stats of weapons, keyed by component id (read by scripts/combat/weapons.gd; the arena also fires the test_* ids without a placed component). kind: laser (hitscan), bolt (projectile), flak (several spread projectiles), missile (slow, homing, splash, passes shields) or beam (a hitscan line held for duration; damage is per second). damage_type: kinetic, energy, explosive or ion. cooldown and duration in seconds, range in pixels, arc in degrees (turrets only), speed in px/s, turn in rad/s, spread in degrees, splash in cells. pierce: how many more solid cells leftover damage may punch through. fire_chance: chance per shot to start a fire at the first cell hit. Kinds have defaults for the keys left out (see weapons.gd). Optional keys: ammo (a material or item id in cargo, one is spent per shot), jam_chance (chance per volley that the weapon seizes up), heat_per_shot (heat added to the part for each shot), breach_chance (chance per hit that a wall cell is breached outright), effects: a list of tags (lock_doors, drain_power, tether) or an object of weapon effects built in scripts/combat/effects.gd, which lists every key (acid, spores, shard, sonic, magnetic, frost, corrode, split_on_shield on the target; self_room, needs_operator, needs_crew_in_room, ammo_mult on the shooter; intercept, for turrets: point defence against missiles); tests/test_fx_effects.gd and test_components.gd validate them. The art looks for art/projectiles/<weapon id> (and <weapon id>_impact) before the kind's. Aiming (docs/CONTENT.md 4 and 4f): a weapon sits in a hull mount and points outward through its wall. turret false is a FIXED gun: it fires along the mount's outward direction, turned up to gimbal degrees toward the cursor, so the ship is aimed. turret true rotates itself within arc degrees (centred on the outward direction) at track degrees per second, aims at the enemy with perfect lead and fires when ready; each shot rolls accuracy minus the target's evasion for a hit (docs/CONTENT.md 4). damage is the FIXED equivalent at the weapon's tier: turret_damage (a share, here 0.6) of it is what a turret really deals. The test_* weapons have gimbal 180: they fire anywhere. rapid true marks the few guns that fire a shot or more a second (shots / cooldown >= 1; a flak volley counts as one shot): they are turrets with damage 1 and a cooldown of 0.4 to 0.8 s, 10 to 15% of the guns, and every other gun stays under one shot a second (tests/test_weapons.gd checks both). sound (optional): the id of the sound it makes when it fires (data/audio.json); it wins over the kind and line sounds (the ten races' signature guns have one; scripts/audio/audio.gd weapon_sound).

shields._doc: Shield timing (scripts/combat/shields.gd, scripts/sim/abilities.gd). recharge: seconds a used layer takes to come back at normal speed; a part's stats.recharge is its own seconds a layer. The used layers of a sector come back one at a time (the next timer starts when the one before it is back). break_delay: seconds more a sector waits for its first layer once its last whole layer is used. tier_recharge and neon_mult: the stats.recharge a pack's shield follows by tier (x neon_mult on the neon line); tests/test_content.gd checks it.
